entries.purpose: Gradle Kotlin build script for chihuahua-rt module; declares Niagara RT module dependencies, Java source sets, and slotomatic configuration.
RT sub-module include descriptor; declares module name, vendor, and dependency versions for chihuahua-rt Niagara module.
RT module permissions; declares Niagara permission categories for chihuahua-rt components.
RT module lexicon; provides i18n display names for chihuahua-rt BComponent types.
RT palette descriptor; declares BChiDashboardService and equipment BComponents for Niagara Workbench palette discovery.
8-slot BComponent for Cárcamo (sump/collection pit) equipment: label, position, planta, nivelCm, state, umbralAdvertencia, umbralCritico.
Cárcamo equipment monitor BComponent; auto-creates BChiCarcamo children for parent BPlanta on started(); seeds from CARCAMO_DATA table.
Root service BComponent; ensures 6 BPlanta containers; schedules controlTick 10s for protection evaluation (inferred from mapping).
9-slot BComponent for Datalogger (pressure sensor): label, position, planta, pressurePsi, pressureBar, state, umbralAdvertencia, umbralCritico.
Datalogger equipment monitor BComponent; auto-creates BChiDatalogger children for parent BPlanta on started(); seeds from datalogger table.
37-slot BComponent for UP (Unidad Paquete) equipment: 1 label, 2 position, 15 numeric feedback, 7 boolean feedback, 5 writable commands, 7 thresholds.
UP equipment monitor BComponent; auto-creates BChiUp children for parent BPlanta on started(); seeds from embedded table.
Planta container BComponent (1..6); auto-creates UpMonitor, CarcamoMonitor, DataloggerMonitor on started(); filters by planta index.
Gradle Kotlin build script for chihuahua-ux module; declares Niagara UX module dependencies, resource packaging, and slotomatic configuration.
UX sub-module include descriptor; declares module name, vendor, and dependency versions for chihuahua-ux Niagara module.
UX module permissions; declares Niagara permission categories for chihuahua-ux servlet access.
UX module lexicon; provides i18n display names for chihuahua-ux servlet and UX types.
UX palette descriptor; declares BChiServlet for Niagara Workbench palette discovery and servlet registration.
BWebServlet routing all /mx60/* requests; delegates to ChiServletDispatch.route(); serves 17 API endpoints + static assets under /mx60/.
Queries BAlarmDatabase; handles alarm latch/unlatch/ack on BChiUp slots; serves /api/alarms, /api/alarmCounts, /api/alarms/notes.
Queries BAlarmDatabase grouped by source ORD; serves /api/alarms/sources and /api/alarms/source endpoints for Reflow alarms UX (ADR-2).
Walks BChiDashboardService station hierarchy; serializes UP, Cárcamo, Datalogger equipment slots to JSON for /api/equipment response.
Queries BHistoryDatabase for MX60 dashboard; ported from SnlsHistoryHelper.java (L21); serves /api/historyList and /api/historyData endpoints.
Stateless JSON utility; escapeJson() for safe string embedding; date/number formatting helpers shared across all ux helper classes.
Enumerates BNumericSchedule instances from station via BOrd walk; serializes schedule data to JSON for /api/schedules response.
Pure routing logic; package-private final class; all routing decisions in route() — pure-Java, WSL-testable without Niagara WebOp dependency.
Reads and writes threshold slots on BChiUp, BChiCarcamo, BChiDatalogger via BOrd walk; serves GET/POST /api/{type}/{ord}/threshold* endpoints.
Component-level CSS; equipment cards, alarm tables, modal dialogs, threshold forms, schedule UI styles for MX60 dashboard.
Main application CSS; layout, header, nav-bar, page sections, footer styles for MX60 dashboard SPA.
Chart.js v4 UMD precompiled bundle; must load before RequireJS to register window.Chart global without AMD conflict.
Chart.js date-fns adapter bundle; provides date/time scale support for Chart.js; must load before RequireJS.
Three.js OrbitControls addon; served via importmap as 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls'; enables 3D orbit interaction in UpDetail.
Three.js RoomEnvironment addon; provides indoor lighting environment for 3D equipment scenes in UpDetail.
Three.js r160 ES module bundle; served via importmap as 'three'; loaded by UpDetail.js and CarcamoDetail.js for 3D equipment visualization.
Inter font — Latin Extended subset, woff2 format; used in MX60 dashboard UI typography.
Inter font — Latin subset, woff2 format; primary body and UI text font for MX60 dashboard.
JetBrains Mono 400 weight — monospace font for data values, alarm codes, and JSON display in MX60 dashboard.
JetBrains Mono 500 weight — medium weight monospace for emphasis in data display in MX60 dashboard.
JetBrains Mono 600 weight — semibold monospace for headers and alarm severity labels in MX60 dashboard.
Full maquila site image; used as background or reference image in MX60 dashboard HomeMap view.
CBRE logo PNG; displayed in MX60 dashboard header or footer branding area.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1-HP state: warning (naranja/orange); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1-HP state: alarm (rojo/red); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1-HP state: normal (verde/green); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1 state: warning (naranja/orange); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1 state: alarm (rojo/red); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P1 state: normal (verde/green); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P2 state: warning (naranja/orange); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P2 state: alarm (rojo/red); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P2 state: normal (verde/green); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P3 state: warning (naranja/orange); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P3 state: alarm (rojo/red); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P3 state: normal (verde/green); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P5 state: warning (naranja/orange); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P5 state: alarm (rojo/red); used in equipment card UI.
Datalogger equipment image — DT-P5 state: normal (verde/green); used in equipment card UI.
Honeywell H icon PNG; used as browser favicon per index.html link rel=icon.
Honeywell full logo PNG; displayed in dashboard header per index.html img src.
SPA entry point; loads IIFE scripts in dependency order; bootstraps MX60.DashboardApp.init() and ParticleAnimation; includes Three.js importmap.
Full-screen alarm detail modal with 3 tabs (Summary, Table, Notes); footer actions: Acknowledge + Hyperlink + Close; §68.4 ANÁLOGO candidate.
Dedicated alarm-source page (#alarms/<encodedOrd>): shows alarm drill-down table for a single source ORD; registered as page 'alarm-detail'.
Alarm details drill-down table: row-action listeners, selection listeners, sortable columns; used as a tab inside AlarmCards.
Client-side latch store per (equipId, alarmKey): sticky until reset, seeded from equipment fetch, write-through POST to /api/alarms/latch|unlatch.
Poptip with 5 action buttons per alarm record (ack, notes, link, etc.); §68.4 ANÁLOGO candidate for ack flow transplant analysis.
Full-screen notes modal: GET + POST to /api/alarms/notes; §68.4 ANÁLOGO candidate for note-gate ack flow; open()/close() API.
In-memory alarm store + fetch layer: caches up to MAX_ALARMS entries, listener-pattern for data changes; ack mutations via /api/alarms.
Alarms page (#alarms): planta-tabs + state-tabs toolbar, 12-card pagination grid, bulk select, CSV export; 20s polling interval via AlarmsManager.
Reusable sticky bulk action bar for selectable lists; displays count of selected items with bulk ack and export actions.
Cárcamo 3D detail renderer: cutaway pit with animated water surface, level bar, sensor LED; color-threshold logic green/orange/red at 45/69%.
Read-through cache + write-through for cárcamo level thresholds; Niagara slots are single source of truth; includes colorForReading() helper.
Fetches and caches /api/config; deduplicated concurrent loads with callbacks; provides reload() and fallback MX60-specific config.
Configuración matrix page: all UPs with modoOperacion chips (MANUAL/SETPOINT/SCHEDULE); click-to-change with 5s undo toast; ModoOverrideStore-backed.
Blocking confirmation dialog: single instance, keyboard Enter/Escape support, neutral/danger tone variants.
Root orchestrator: boots ConfigManager and Router, manages page lifecycle (mount/destroy on nav), registers all page modules.
Datalogger detail renderer: hero image by pressure state (VERDE/NARANJA/ROJO), reading panel, threshold form backed by DataloggerThresholdStore.
Read-through cache + write-through for datalogger pressure thresholds (inverted: lectura < umbral = degraded); Niagara slots single source of truth.
Equipment page: planta-tab toolbar + 12-card pagination grid; groups by planta then type (UP → Cárcamo → Datalogger); destroy() cleans listeners.
Single source of truth for equipment list: BajaScript subscription primary, REST 5s polling fallback; listener pattern for UI consumers.
Dispatch-by-type orchestrator: reads route equipId from EquipmentData, routes to registered detail renderer; supports registerRenderer(type, fn) API.
Aggregator between EquipmentData and UI: coalesces BajaScript pushes into 1 throttled flush via rAF + 500ms cap; ring buffer per equipId.
Home map page: clickable SVG plant zones over MAQUILA photo; sidebar with planta on/standby/alarm counts; popover with equipment list on zone click.
In-memory ring buffer (120 pts/equipId) for live equipment snapshots; data layer only, no rendering; ported from SanLuis HistoryChart ring-buffer.
Optimistic override for modoOperacion per UP while writePoint propagates to Niagara; in-memory only; publish-subscribe pattern for cross-tab sync.
Optimistic override for device commands (fan, comp1, comp2) per UP in MANUAL mode; cleared on MANUAL exit; mirrors ModoOverrideStore pattern.
Header canvas particle animation: network-style RAF loop; exposes destroy() + pause()/resume() for lifecycle cleanup.
Hash-based router: parses #page/params, dispatches onNavigate callback, manages hashchange listener lifecycle.
Schedules page (#schedules): auto-discovers BWeeklySchedule objects via /api/schedules; iframe-modal slot editor (inferred from mapping).
Shared PMREM environment texture for all 3D detail scenes; off-screen renderer kept alive to share GPU texture across short-lived scene renderers.
Single source of truth for effective equipment status: overrides underlying status with alarm when AlarmLatchStore.hasAnyLatched(id) is true.
BajaScript subscription pool: registers point subscribers, watchdog reconnect on silence, teardown on cleanup() (inferred from mapping).
15-preset time-range dropdown; selection persists to localStorage; uses MX60.util.Dropdown for iSMA 4.13.2 embedded-browser styling compat.
Bottom-right toast queue with optional undo window; Gmail-style commit/undo pattern; single active toast at a time.
MX60 UP detail page: 37-slot panel with MANUAL/SETPOINT/SCHEDULE modes, threshold UI, history chart, write logic, BajaScript subscription lifecycle.
Read-through cache + write-through for UP protection thresholds; Niagara slots are single source of truth; seedFromEquipment seeds from REST load.
Canonical write helper: BajaScript p.set() primary path, REST POST /api/setpoint fallback; _bajaSetBroken dual-path selection (inferred from mapping).
RFC 4180 CSV download utility: columnsDef with getValue lambdas, pure browser Blob + URL.createObjectURL; no external dependencies.
Generic custom dropdown factory replacing native select for theming in iSMA 4.13.2 embedded browser; single-active enforcement.
Single shared body-level popover: click-outside, ESC, scroll to close; attach factory returns open()/close()/destroy() instance.
Spanish relative-time formatter: buckets from seconds to weeks; format() for relative, absolute() for full locale date. No dependencies.
Root Niagara module descriptor; declares module identity, vendor, and sub-module references for chihuahua-rt and chihuahua-ux.
